scope: Prospective layout and access control, not physical data or timings. No simulations, trajectories, paid calls, physical training or scoring. Preprocessing requires separate Main-signed release commit. Index 6 never opened; no legacy eval or prior physical cache reused.
inputs: Pinned release-index.json; per-index npz_sha256 and sidecar_sha256; selected bXX_fit/dev/eval native TRAIN rows in WORK/rosters.npz verified against PUB/lineage.json and stage release. Exact seed/id must agree with release and disjoint per-beta eval; one pass through species.npy in increasing selected native-row order for the union of fit+dev. Compressed whole-source SHA is checked before that single decompression. ZIP implementation can internally skip past denied bytes, never exports a denied parent. No archive-scale uncompressed cache. Never reread source to benchmark. No beta dropped; nonempty roster required for each admitted index.
geometry: No rotations, z,y,x C-order with x contiguous; full ternary uint8 species 0=vac,1=A,2=B. V lex [-1,1]^3, E lex maxnorm=4 all 386 sites, I=(vac,A) aggregate counts inside [-3,3]^3. R5 is NOT computed in these primary streams. A separately released R5 diagnostic would require promotion. Discovery PCG64([26112502,index,native_row]).choice(8000,64,replace=False) in draw order. Blind/hidden use same seed, lex grid {0,10}^3 plus uniform random triple of integers 0..9; 8 disjoint R4 cubes on L20.
storage: WORK/streams/bXX/{fit,dev}/{V,E,I,parent,anchor}.npy; V uint8[N,64,27], E uint8[N,64,386], I uint16-le[N,64,2], parent int32-le[N] native row in roster order, anchor uint8[N,64,3] z,y,x. Publication barrier PUB/stream-bXX.json, pins rosters_sha256,source_sha256,release_sha256 and roles[role].files[filename].sha256 and bytes. Measured timing includes fsync, hash time separate, logical MB/s and Linux process IO distinguished; representative CPU batch gather excludes training/device transfer. Per-beta coverage and aggregate completion PUB/stream-summary.json.
release: PUB/stream-release-1.json {stage:'fit-dev',design_sha256,lineage_sha256,rosters_sha256}; release, design.json, lineage.json, stream-design.json and extractor must match committed public revision. Private source species is read only after all gates pass. No eval arrays, hidden labels or forecast scoring created by fit-dev. Fail closed on an unfinished output rather than silently retrying.
pilot: WORK/streams/packet.{npz,json} after all admitted fit streams complete. Packet contents only V uint8[N,64,27], E uint8[N,64,386], parent int32[N] native row, beta int16[N] release index; S computed inside fitting from V, never passed to encoder. First min(64,nfit) in roster order at every allowed beta; at least 8 parents/beta, 64 MiB bound both on uncompressed arrays and stored bytes. This is a bounded timing/throughput pilot, not training coverage. No dev/eval/I, raw archives, barred rows, credentials, scores or auxiliary labels; local construction is not upload authority.
blind: Explicit CLI blind --index I --release-commit REV only after committed PUB/blind-release-bXX.json stage=blind with index, design_sha256, lineage_sha256, rosters_sha256, rule_file, forecast_file and prerequisites basename-to-SHA (including both frozen files). WORK/streams/bXX/blind contains only parent, anchor, E and I for bXX_eval (Q=8). For I compute global [2000,2400] minus aggregate counts in contiguous complement runs outside this anchor's cavity; no microscopic V or halo labels are built. Receipt PUB/stream-blind-bXX.json. Never called automatically.
hidden: Separate CLI hidden and PUB/hidden-release-bXX.json stage=hidden, same base/frozen-file pins. For EVERY admitted beta, first require committed predictions-bXX.npz with parent,anchor,m0,m1 exact order, m0/m1 finite float[N,8] signed same-f forecasts; committed predictions-bXX.json links index, stage='predictions', prediction_sha256, blind_sha256 (public blind receipt), rule_sha256 and forecast_sha256. Check exact roster, deterministic coordinates and full committed blind receipt at every beta before reading any hidden V. Only then selectively return the authorized V spans for bXX_eval, never E or I; output WORK/streams/bXX/hidden/{parent,anchor,V}.npy, PUB/stream-hidden-bXX.json. No hidden stage if no qualifying f/predictions. Physical stage clock checks continue inside extraction. Main alone issues either eval release.
